## Summary

Describe the user-visible or developer-facing change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`, or an explanation is included below
- [ ] Manual verification is described when behavior changed

## Impact

- [ ] Tests cover changed parser, storage, routing, or request behavior
